items.title: Mock 1 — Listening Fill in the Blanks Q2 (Driving License Test Preparation)
items.audioText: The driving school is always busy during the summer as many students sign up for lessons. They want to get their licenses before school starts. The instructor is responsible for teaching them how to drive safely. They are requiring each student to demonstrate their ability to handle the car properly. This ensures everyone is ready for the road. Passing the test is a big achievement for new drivers.
